Humanoid hands have four fingers plus one thumb and natural wrists. Scrapper is kind beaked ant alien with four arms, two bare clawed legs, metallic-knit sleeveless top, separate teal wrap and canvas powered-tool belt. Private guards wear cream uniforms and cobalt armor. Ship is the approved broad ivory/teal Harrier motorhome, stubby wings, one fin, four side vector nozzles, fixed recessed forward nose radar and missing machinery covers. No external radar dish or pre-Harrier twin engine pods. Clean landscape16:9 single starter frame, no titles, borders, rulers, readable Earth text or montage. Close over the shoulders of Harper left and Taffy right looking at cockpit monitor, Taffy hand poised to point but not blocking display. Monitor fills middle half of image: alien news presenter wearing worklike grey high-collar tunic in left panel, LIVE yard inset right with ochre low TRACKED clearance tug broad front dozer/grapple assembly amber lamps in circular port. Along bottom stylized ring diagram of port and two square terminal icons, glyph rows and amber segmented countdown. This is a physical screen in cabin, not split-screen whole artwork.
